agent_notes: All six supplied 2025 NIRF directory pages list the exact institution name with city LUCKNOW and state Uttar Pradesh.
Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; after confirming the expected public hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure only.

The official main site links the Lucknow campus site. The 2026-27 official programme PDF, active official programme pages, and linked 2026-27 Ph.D admissions page were combined to avoid omissions; grouped programme rows retain the exact catalogue wording.

General programme eligibility was not stated in the central official catalogue and remains null. The linked doctoral admissions page explicitly states the relevant Master's Degree/M.Phil with minimum 55% requirement, which is recorded only for doctoral courses.
No certificate programme was identified in the current official 2026-27 programme catalogue; the homepage Certificate link is an institutional ISO certificate page, not a student programme.
